item.title: Man shot neighbor's barking dog in north St. Louis County, police say
item.description: A man faces criminal charges after police say he shot his neighbor's barking dog in north St. Louis County.

item.title: Teen certified as adult, charged with murder in deadly Schnucks shooting
item.description: A teenager has been certified to stand trial as an adult and charged with two felonies in connection with a deadly shooting inside a Schnucks grocery store last year.

item.title: Officials say hundreds waiting for mental healthcare in a jail cell
item.description: Public administrators in Missouri want the state to provide better care for the hundreds of residents who remain in jail awaiting both a trial and a bed to become available at a state psychiatric facility.

item.title: Forest Park still in recovery months after May tornado
item.description: Nine months after the May 16 tornado struck St. Louis, Forest Park is still recovering from the damage caused.

item.title: Deadly Starbucks shooting suspect charged
item.description: A man charged with murder for a shooting at a south St. Louis Starbucks drive-thru is linked to other robberies.

item.title: STL City creating data center regulations
item.description: The framework attempts to address environmental concerns while keeping the door open for data centers.

item.title: 5 women shatter barriers in St. Louis Fire Department
item.description: History for the St. Louis Fire Department, as five Black women have been promoted to fire captain. They each have their own unique stories, but they credit their teamwork and common vision for getting them here.

item.title: Local families react to Nancy Guthrie disappearance
item.description: The national search for Savannah Guthrie’s missing mother is reigniting a painful truth: when someone disappears, families are left to live with endless uncertainty.

item.title: Family hopes for oversight change after woman dies in jail
item.description: The St. Louis Detention Facilities Oversight Board revealed Tuesday that it was never formally notified by city leadership regarding the recent death of 32-year-old Dametria McDile at the city jail.

item.title: Skating Coach identified as victim in fatal Starbucks drive-thru shooting
item.description: A local figure skating club is mourning the loss of one of its coaches, who has now been identified as the woman who was shot and killed at a Starbucks drive-thru Tuesday in St. Louis' Tower Grove East neighborhood.
